title: ToolPermissionEvent
description: Compliance evidence record of a tool permission decision (cap-004). Included in DSSE signing scope.

capsule_id.description: Run capsule ULID that owns this event

event_id.description: Stable UUID for this decision instance

policy_id.description: Policy document that produced the decision

authorising_identity.description: Principal that the policy engine resolved as the authorising identity

human_approval_required.description: True if the policy required a human-in-the-loop approval

human_approval_obtained.description: True if human approval was obtained; null if not required

approval_principal.description: Identity of the human approver; null if not required

decision_latency_ms.description: Wall-clock latency of the policy decision in milliseconds
